headline: Testing of voting machines and ballots before the November 3rd State Election.
summary: Election officials will test various voting equipment and ballots. The testing prepares for the November 3rd State Election.
items: Note: the English text gives the start date as October 24, 2026, but the Chinese text gives October 22, 2026
location: Room 106, City Council Chambers, first floor, 215 Pleasant St., Malden City Hall
plain_text:
NOTICE OF PRE-ELECTION VOTING MACHINE AND 
BALLOT TESTING 
  
Election Officials from the City Clerk’s Office will meet to begin the process 
of testing various voting equipment in preparation of the November 3rd State 
Election. Testing will begin at or about 10:00 AM on October 24, 2026, and 
will proceed until finished. Testing will take place in Room 106, the City 
Council Chambers, first floor 215 Pleasant St., Malden City Hall.  
  
  
選舉前投票機及選票測試公告 
  
市書記辦公室的選舉工作人員將進行各項投票設備的測試工作， 
為11月3日的州初選 做好準備。 
測試將於2026年10月22日上午約10時開始，並持續至全部測試完成為
止。 
測試地點為摩頓市政廳一樓106室市議會會議廳，地址: 215 派臣街
（Pleasant St.）。
